title: BOX OF GLASSWARE & CERAMICS
reason: Gilded cobalt bowl set and a cased glass vase add some value to an otherwise general box, but nothing is marked.
findings: Mixed box. Glass: a set of four cobalt blue glass bowls (one large and three small, two on short feet) with a wide gold band of grape vine decoration between narrow gilt lines, Bohemian style, no marks seen; a blue cased handkerchief (fazzoletto) vase with white interior and a patch of orange, green and red streaks (Murano or Czech style, unmarked in the photo); an amber crackle glass pedestal bowl with a central cylinder and applied side handles; a blue glass flower on a green glass block; an amber faceted glass ashtray. Other: a pair of Japanese style lustre glaze character steins with tavern scenes, a gold-rimmed tankard with half-timbered house and veteran car, a bone china style mug with a rural scene and script caption (not fully legible), a white toast rack with black rim, a four-panel Chinese calligraphy table screen, a red lacquered resin pen stand, a marble or soapstone trinket box, and a small quartz desk clock with barometer and thermometer (no brand legible). No hallmarks, signatures or labels found.
condition: No obvious chips or cracks in the photos; gilt on the bowls looks bright with minor rim wear. Bases are hidden by the photo angle.
rescore_note: Value is in the gilded cobalt Bohemian-style bowl set and a cased Murano or Czech style vase, both unmarked; the rest is general glass, steins and trinkets, so lower part of the $80 to 200 band. (no web price check)
